description.content: Endpoints for managing comments and reactions on Figma files, including creating, listing, and deleting comments.
Gets a list of comments left on the file. Comments are returned in order of creation, with the most recent comments first. By default, only root-level comments and their direct replies are returned.

description.content:
Figma allows designers to create and prototype their digital experiences -
together in real-time and in one place - helping them turn their ideas and
visions into products, faster. Figma's mission is to make design
accessible to everyone. The Figma API is one of the ways we aim to do that.
